Window your game. 
Change the size of the image of all the darts to match the size of the game. Put them side by side.

Then count the colours to where your dude is, and then count that on the image. 
Match the height with the dart in the game, against the dart in the same position in the image.

Thats the angle of the dart you are trying to release on.

This doesnt include wind, but without wind, its one to one. 
Keep practicing that, then you will work out the wind slowly over time.
